1.o: تتمكّن الأفاتار "كورا" من السيطرة على الماء والأرض والنار، وتتطلّع الآن لبدء التدرّب للسيطرة على الهواء، لكن المشكلة في المدينة تعرقل خططها.

2.o: بعد حلّ المشكلة في تدريبها للسيطرة على الهواء مع المعلّم "تنزن"، تزور "كورا" حلبة الفرسان بحثًا عن الإلهام.

3.o: تتسلّل "كورا" إلى حركة جماعة "المواساة" وتكتشف المزيد عن قائدها الغامض. وحين يتعرّض "بولن" للاختطاف، يأتي "ماكو" و"كورا" لإنقاذه.

4.o: تُجنَّد "كورا" للانضمام إلى "تارلوك"، العضو في المجلس، والباحث عن وسيلة لتحرير المدينة من قبضة جماعة "المواساة".

5.o: تكافح "كورا" وزميلاها في فريق "دبابير النار" من أجل التسامح والعمل سويًّا كفريق بعد أن أدّت بعض المنافسات الرومانسية إلى اختلال توازنهم.

6.o: تستعدّ "كورا" وفريق "دبابير النار" لدورة بطولة الأبطال، ولكن هل يمكن أن تستمرّ اللعبة فيما يلوح تهديد شرّير في الحلبة؟

7.o: تراود "كورا" الشكوك في أن أحد حلفائها ربما يعمل لصالح جماعة "المواساة"، فيما يُدين "تارلوك" "لين" علنًا ويطالب باستقالتها.

8.o: تواجه "كورا" المستشار "تارلوك"، الذي يتّخذ إجراءات صارمة ضدّ "مدينة الشعب" حين تبدأ حركة جماعة "المواساة" في النموّ واكتساب القوّة.

9.o: تحاول "كورا" تفسير رؤاها المُبهَمة، فيما يبحث "تنزن" و"بيفونغ" عن رهائن جماعة "المواساة"، لكن خطّتهما تستند إلى معلومات خاطئة… فهل ينجحان؟

10.o: تشنّ جماعة "المواساة" هجومًا شرسًا على "مدينة الشعب". وفي خضمّ المعركة، يختبئ فرسان الهواء، ويولَد طفل، وتستجيب السفن الحربية لنداء المدينة.

11.o: بينما تشتدّ ضراوة الحرب، تكتشف "كورا" سرًّا حول الثورة ضدّ الفرسان، ويستولي رفاق "كورا" على أحد معاقل جماعة "المواساة".

12.o: تواجه "كورا" قائد جماعة "المواساة" الغامض مع اشتداد وطأة الحرب على "مدينة الشعب"، فهل تمتلك من القوّة ما يؤهّلها لهزيمته؟

1.o: تكافح "كورا" من أجل أن تتّصل بعالم الأرواح أثناء حضورها وفريقها المهرجان الذي أقامته "جماعة الماء الجنوبية".

2.o: في رحلة إلى القطب الجنوبي، تسافر "كورا" و"أونالاك" عبر دوامة خطيرة ويعثران على مصدر للطاقة الروحانية.

3.o: بينما تتوتّر العلاقات بين "جماعة الماء الشمالية" ونظيرتها الجنوبية، تكافح "كورا" لتلتزم الحياد، لكن عليها إنقاذ "أونالاك" من محاربي الجنوب.

4.o: تحارب "كورا" من أجل حرّية والديها حين يُقبض عليهما بعد أن لُفقَت لهما تهمة، فيما يعيد كلّ من "تنزن" و"إيكي" التواصل مع أشقّائهما.

5.o: عندما يرفض رئيس "الجمهورية المتّحدة" مساعدة "كورا"، تقرّر أن تتولّى زمام الأمور بنفسها.

6.o: عندما تهدّد أنشطة عصابة ثالوث بإنهاء صناعات المستقبل، يجري "ماكو" تحقيقًا ويكتشف مؤامرة كبرى.

7.o: تكتشف "كورا" الأصول الملحمية لأوّل أفاتار أسطوري، والذي كان يكافح في عالم يغمره الفقر والجوع منذ عشرة آلاف سنة.

8.o: تخوض "كورا" في ماضي الأفاتار وتتعرّف على الأمور التي تحتاج إليها لإعادة التوازن بين عالم الأرواح والعالم المادي.

9.o: تطلب "كورا" من "تنزن" مساعدتها في الدخول إلى عالم الأرواح للمرّة الأولى، فيما يلفّق "فيريك" تهمة لـ"ماكو"، الذي ألقت الشرطة القبض عليه.

10.o: تدخل "كورا" إلى عالم الأرواح، حيث تواجه صعوبة بسبب العلاقة بين الأفاتار والأرواح.

11.o: ينقذ "بولن" الموقف عندما يتعرّض الرئيس "رايكو" للهجوم، بينما تتحدّث "كورا" مع "فيريك" بشأن الحصول على مساعدته لإحباط خطط "أونالاك".

12.o: تعمل "كورا" وفريقها على إغلاق بوابات الأرواح قبل "التقارب التوافقي" بعدما يتنامى إلى علمهم هزيمة الثوار الجنوبيين.

13.o: تكتشف "كورا" مفاجأة جديدة في خطّة "أونالاك" الآثمة، ويدرك "تنزن" ضرورة مواجهته لهواجسه كي ينقذ ابنته… فهل يحالفه الحظّ؟

14.o: بعدما تتعافى "كورا" من هجوم شنّه "أونالاك"، تكتشف طريقة تمكّنها من هزيمة أقوى روح ظلام… وبذلك تنقذ العالم.

1.o: بعد "التقارب التوافقي"، تكتشف "كورا" أن "مدينة الشعب" تحلّ بها نازلة غير متوقّعة، وتتولّد فجأة لدى "بومي" وآخرين قدرة على التحكّم في الهواء.

2.o: بينما تعمل "كورا" و"تنزن" وفريق الأفاتار على تجنيد مقاتلي هواء جدد واستعادة "أمّة الهواء"، يبدأ المجرم الآثم "زهير" في تشكيل فريقه الخطير.

3.o: يتوجّه الفريق إلى "با سينغ ساي" للتفاوض مع ملكة الأرض لأجل تجنيد مقاتلي هواء جدد، ويتواصل "ماكو" و"بولن" مع أسرة لم يلتقياها أبدًا.

4.o: بعدما تكتشف "كورا" أنّ ملكة الأرض تعكف على احتجاز مقاتلي الهواء في "با سينغ ساي"، تقرّر أنّه يجب على الفريق البقاء وتقديم المساعدة.

5.o: بينما يتسلّل "زهير" إلى جزيرة "معبد الهواء" محاولًا العثور على الأفاتار، يقصد الفريق و"لين بيفونغ" مدينة "زافو" لمقابلة مقاتل هواء جديد.

6.o: تمكث "كورا" في "زافو" وتتدرّب على التحكّم بالمعادن، وتخضع "لين بيفونغ" للوخز بالإبر لتستعيد الذكريات وتتحكّم في استيائها من ماضيها مع "سو".

7.o: يواجه مقاتلو الهواء الجدد صعوبة في التكيّف مع طرق تدريب "تنزن"، إلى أن تتدخّل "باما" بمشورة حكيمة حول التكامل الثقافي.

8.o: بينما تستعدّ "أوبل" لمغادرة "زافو" وبدء تدريب مقاتلي الهواء، يتسلّل "زهير" وعصابته "اللوتس الحمراء" إلى المدينة ويخطفون الأفاتار.

9.o: يسافر الفريق إلى أعماق "مملكة الأرض"، حيث يبحث "بولن" و"ماكو" عن مكان "آيوي"، وتسعى "كورا" لمعرفة معلومات حول "اللوتس الحمراء".

10.o: تتقطع السبل بـ"كورا" و"أسامي" في صحراء "سي وانغ" ويضطر "ماكو" و"بولن" للانتظار في السجن ريثما تبرم "اللوتس الحمراء" اتفاقًا مع "ملكة الأرض".

11.o: تعمّ الفوضى "با سينغ ساي"، بينما يبحث "ماكو" و"بولن" عن "كورا" و"أسامي" في صحراء "سي وانغ" ويحاولان تحذير "تنزن" من خطط "اللوتس الحمراء".

12.o: تضحّي "كورا" بنفسها لإنقاذ أسرى "اللوتس الحمراء"، ويستفيد "بولن" من مهاراته الجديدة في قتال الحمم، ويسدّد "زهير" ضربته إلى الأفاتار.

13.o: تسود الفوضى بينما تحارب "كورا" والفريق "زهير" وعصابته "اللوتس الحمراء، وتتقلّد "جينورا" منصبًا جديدًا وتدلي بتصريح يخصّ "أمة الهواء".

1.o: بعد سفر "كورا" لمدّة ستّة أشهر وإخفاء هويّتها الحقيقية، تستعدّ لجمع شملها مع فريق الأفاتار مرّة أخرى في "مدينة الشعب" المزدهرة من جديد.

2.o: تسترجع "كورا" صعابًا عانت منها خلال السنوات الأخيرة الماضية أثناء تعافيها من أثر ما سمّمها به "زهير"، وتكرّس نفسها لاستعادة مهارات السيطرة.

3.o: ثمّة شكوك في قدرة الأمير على تولّي الزعامة، فيما يأمر "تنزن" أطفاله بالبحث عن "كورا" التي تختبئ بينما تتدرّب في "المستنقع الضبابي".

4.o: تزداد حدّة توتر أطفال "تنزن" وهم يواصلون البحث عن "كورا"، التي تحاول اكتشاف مكان مقاتلي الهواء بينما تبدأ في تقبّل أحداث ماضيها.

5.o: تقاوم "سو" وأفراد المدينة المعدنية كي يحافظوا على حرّيتهم من هيمنة "كوفيرا"، في حين تعود "كورا" إلى "زافو" لتتفاوض مع "إمبراطورية الأرض".

6.o: تقرّر "كورا"، كونها مجبرة على الاختيار، فعل ما يلزم من أجل "سو" والمدينة المعدنية… إنّه اختبار حقيقي لتعافيها، وتدريبها، وحالتها الذهنية!

7.o: تسبّب عودة "كورا" إلى وطنها في "مدينة الشعب" سعادة يعتريها الأسى حيث تخبر "تنزن" أوّلًا عن معركة "زافو" ثم تجتمع بـ"أسامي" و"ماكو" ثانيةً.

8.o: يتحدث الفريق عن ذكريات الماضي لاكتساب القوة لخوض التحديات المستقبلية، حيث يتذكر "ماكو" أول مرة التقى فيها بـ"كورا"… أما هي، فتشكك في قيمتها.

9.o: بعدما تأسر كروم الأرواح مجموعة من السيّاح، تقاطع "كورا" و"أوبل" اجتماعًا يعقده قادة العالم لتسليط الضوء على خطط "كوفيرا".

10.o: تنطلق "أوبل" و"بولن" و"لين" في مهمّة لإنقاذ "سو" وعائلتها، فيما تطلب "كورا" مساعدة الأرواح في الدفاع عن المدينة ضدّ "كوفيرا".

11.o: تعلن "كوفيرا" عن خططها لتستعيد "جمهورية الأمم المتحدة" لأجل "إمبراطورية الأرض"، ويتعيّن على فريق الأفاتار تحذير "مدينة الشعب" من خطر وشيك.

12.o: بعدما يهرب فريق الأفاتار بشقّ الأنفس، يطلب المساعدة من "هيروشي ساتو" في وضع خطّة للتسلّل إلى بزّة "كوفيرا" المغناطيسية الشرسة وتدميرها.

13.o: تتّحد "كورا" وفريق الأفاتار في معركة نهائية لهزيمة "كوفيرا" وإعادة إحلال السلام في "جمهورية الأمم المتحدة"… فهل ينجح الأمر ويعمّ السلام؟

1.o: Responsible Taihei has to deal with his lazy little sister, Umaru, who trashes his apartment and throws tantrums to get manga and junk food.

2.o: Taihei comes home to a complete stranger: Umaru’s public face. She’s cleaned the apartment and hidden her games to be able to invite her classmate and neighbor, Ebina, over.

3.o: Umaru’s sulky, glaring classmate, Motoba, has unexpectedly shown up at her door… while she’s wearing her hood! Is her secret out?

4.o: Umaru, aka UMR, is a force to be reckoned with in the arcade. She’s invited to participate in a fighting game championship only to bump into her school rival, Tachibana.

5.o: Summer vacation means hours at the arcade! Umaru instructs in the fine art of enjoying summer like a (lazy) pro. Later, Taihei endures another typical day at work.

6.o: Taihei and Umaru experiment with free time and personal space in their little apartment, and playing “The Game of Life” hits too close to home for them all.

7.o: People in his office have seen Taihei walking home and going shopping with a hot girl! His coworker comes over for a visit to see this so-called “sister” for himself.

8.t: Umaru and Christmas and New Year's
8.o: In the Doma household, winter means lazy days beneath the kotatsu! Umaru reflects on her interesting year while Taihei tries to collect on a promise she made to him.

9.o: It’s Valentine’s Day! Kirie burns cookies, Ebina attempts to make chocolate, and Umaru continues to offload food prep to Taihei.

10.t: Umaru and Now and Once Upon a Time
10.o: Umaru gets sick, but it’s a good thing her germs are as lazy as she is! Sadly, her germs show her brother no mercy. Later, Taihei remembers a day at the arcade, 10 years ago.

11.o: Umaru and Ebina discover that their appetites match, the council in Umaru’s head furiously debates about the perfect snack, and Taihei tries to get Kirie excited for summer.

12.o: In this last episode of the season, Umaru might have to reveal her secret when her separate circles of friends come together during a much anticipated trip to the beach!

1.o: Umaru Doma's life continues with an evening filled with video games... and no big brother in sight! Later, Umaru and her friends end up playing an intense game of soccer.

2.o: Taihei invites his coworkers over for dinner after work, and one of them, Alex, catches Umaru's attention. Why does this guy seem so familiar, and what's his deal with anime?

3.o: Alex interrupts Kirie and Umaru's afternoon to play a dating sim game. Kirie finds herself identifying with the main character. Later, Umaru discovers an addictive new game.

4.t: A Party with the Whole Gang
4.o: Umaru spends Christmas evening with her friends, and Sylphyn remembers a childhood Christmas wish. On New Year's morning, Umaru receives a suspicious gift from Taihei.

5.o: Taihei leaves for a business trip with his co-workers. While his boss Kanau thinks of a way to spend time with him, Taihei has his hands full with a vacation-happy stowaway.

6.o: While visiting Umaru, Kirie’s secret aspiration is found out! Will Umaru’s encouragement be enough to help Kirie overcome her self-doubt?

7.o: Umaru and the girls head out to spend a fun day at the amusement park, but Kirie is having a few struggles. Will the day end up a total disaster?

8.o: Umaru and the gang have a spontaneous get-together, but when things don't go as expected, hilarity ensues.

9.o: After Bomba gives Taihei one of his old cameras, Taihei spends sometime reconnecting with Umaru. Later, the tension between Hikari and Umaru increases.

10.o: Sylphin invites UMR over to her house, where a slight misunderstanding leads to some awkwardness. Later on, Umaru seems to have found a weakness in Hikari’s armor.

11.o: Kirie devises a new plan to bring Ebina and Taihei closer. However, Taihei might have a couple to many little sisters fighting for his attention already.

12.o: It's the end of the year, and everyone is figuring out what Christmas gifts to get their loved ones. Can Umaru and the others find the perfect presents?

1.o: Goryeo Prince Wang So is summoned back to the palace by his father the king, after having been exiled since childhood. While on a quest to find the men responsible for his father's assassination attempt, he meets Shin Yool, a merchant who is trying to escape marriage with a powerful general.

2.o: After having married Shin Yool to save her from marrying the General, Wang So leaves to pursue his father's would-be assassins. The king decrees the marriage of Wang So with Princess Yeo-Won as he asks Wang So to find the nobles who had fatally poisoned him. Meanwhile, Shin Yool decides to leave Gaebong for Goryeo.

1.o: Despite his financial situation and her mother's disapproval, Maya is in love with Eiad. Maya's life is turned upside down when a woman gives her a caramel that enables her to read men's thoughts.

2.o: Fares receives his cousin Raga. Maya tells her friend Rahaf about her new ability. Maya meets Raga. She is shocked to learn that Eiad is cheating on her with her friend Dalia.

3.o: When Raga learns of Fouad's plan to buy a medical factory and turn it into a cosmetics factory, he decides to intervene and buy the factory instead. Carla lies to her friends and tells them that she is getting married to Raga.

4.o: As Raga prepares to buy the factory, Fares warns him about Fouad. Carla informs her brother Fouad of her plan to marry Raga. Maya looks for a new job after quitting her old one.

5.o: When Maya learns of a job vacancy, she is shocked to discover that it's in Raga's company. Raga hires Maya as his secretary. Carla keeps watching over Raga.

6.o: Carla pretends to be a charitable person who helps those in need so that Raga will like her. Maya helps Raga buy the factory.

7.o: Nagham tells Fares that she borrowed money from Raga to renovate the agency. Walid tells Fouad that Raga is watching them, but it's actually Maya's ability that caused the problem.

8.o: When Fouad visits Raga, Maya learns about his plot against Raga as Fouad tries to get her to spy for him. Maya gets jealous when she sees Carla flirting with Raga.

9.o: Raga gets the factory and asks Walid to work for him. It's revealed that Walid is spying on Raga for Fouad. Maya discovers that her brother Fadi is seeing Dalia.

10.o: Fadi quarrels with Eiad. Maya warns Fadi about Dalia. Fares has an accident and Nagham supports him. Maya tries to help people when she becomes privy to some dangerous thoughts.

11.o: When Maya starts to fall for Raga, she tells Rahaf that the woman who gave her the caramel told her that love makes the caramel ineffective. Nagham confesses her feelings for Fares, as Raga confesses his love for Maya.

12.o: Raga tells Fares about his feelings for Maya. Rahaf tries to get close to Fares so that she could achieve her dream of being a model. Maya leaves the house when Fadi continues to grow close to Dalia.

13.o: As Fadi searches Maya's stuff, he learns that she can read men's minds. Carla learns that Raga likes Maya.

14.o: Fadi threatens Maya to get her to help him graduate without having to study. Rahaf helps Fares after he gets beaten.

15.o: Carla lies to Raga and claims that Fouad seized her fortune. She succeeds in stir discord between Raga and Maya.

16.o: Raga learns that Fares' mother has Alzheimer's. Fouad forces Walid to sell the land. Rahaf advises Maya not to give up on Raga that easily. Rahaf loses her money in a gambling game that Fares dragged her into. Carla and Eiad plot against Maya.

17.o: Eiad informs Raga that he is still in love with Maya. Maya vows revenge on Fouad. Carla offers to partner up with Raga after she buys the land next to his factory. Raga apologizes to Maya.

18.o: Carla decides to launch her own cosmetics product despite her knowledge of how dangerous the product is. Maya agrees to marry Raga.

19.o: Carla gets upset when she learns that Raga got engaged. Maya learns that Dalia and Fadi are still seeing each other. When Fadi is kicked out of the house, Raga helps him. Nagham and Rahaf prepare for a fashion show.

20.o: Maya threatens Dalia to get her to leave Fadi. Carla invites Raga over and sets him up. Maya suspects that Raga is unfaithful.

21.o: Raga lies to Maya. Nagham is distressed when she learns that Fares confessed his love for Rahaf. Maya learns that Raga cheated on her with Carla.

22.o: Maya breaks up with Raga and decides to take revenge on her former boss, Adel. Fouad and Carla agree to try and recruit Rahaf to help them against Maya.

23.o: When Fadi tells Dalia that Maya can read men's minds, Dalia informs Carla. Fouad learns that Jomana and Raga are collaborating to license and release a new drug.

24.o: When Maya decides to appear on Nabil Ghosn's show, Revealing The Hidden, she uses her ability to expose him on air. As the video goes viral, Maya decides to start working in sorcery and magic.

25.o: As Maya starts her new line of work, Carla confesses her feelings for Raga who doesn't share her feelings. Eiad plots against Maya. Fares' mother takes a new medicine that helps her remember.

26.o: Jomana is upset to learn about what Maya has done. She is thrilled to learn that her new medicine is working. Maya is kidnapped by Fouad's men.

27.o: Jomana receives a threatening voice note. When Carla discovers where Maya is being kept, she tells Eiad to free her so that she could see him as her heroic savior and leave Raga.

28.o: Maya confirms that Eiad is lying to her. When Rahaf is offered a job as a model in Italy, Fares refuses to go with her. Fadi leaves Dalia when he learns that she is cheating on him. Raga proposes to Carla.

29.o: Maya is shocked to learn that Raga and Carla got engaged. Layal takes revenge on Carla by revealing her scheme to Maya who releases a video of Carla's plot against Raga. As Raga leaves Carla, Fouad is arrested. Fares proposes to Nagham.

30.o: As Maya and Raga reconcile, Maya learns that her aunt Jomana is the one who came up with the caramel formula. As she tries to reverse its effects, Maya acquires the ability to read children's minds instead.

1.t: It Actually Feels Like I Started My Job
1.o: It's Aoba Suzukaze's first day at Eagle Jump. Will she fit in? Will she be able to make friends? Are her coworkers nice? There are a lot of worries for the young girl straight out of high school. However, she encounters her largest challenge as she leaves the office to use the restroom.

2.t: So This is an Adult Drinking Party...
2.o: It's Aoba Suzukaze's second week on the job. She's learning the job quickly and gets assigned to her first project. At the end of the week, the character team throws her a welcome party. With alcohol coming and going, Aoba gets one step closer to adulthood.

3.t: What Happens If I'm Late to Work?
3.o: Aoba Suzukaze sleeps in and may be late to work. Will she arrive late and get in trouble? Or will she prevail? However, that's not the only challenge in her way. She's also having difficulties with the 3D model. Can she get the approval from Ko?

4.o: Aoba Suzukaze receives her first paycheck ever, and a discussion for how to spend it begins at the office. Her colleagues spent their first paychecks on a variety of things like clothes and vacations. How will Aoba spend hers?

5.t: That's How Many Nights We Have To Stay Over?
5.o: It's summer! It's hot! It's the season of fewer clothes. However, some of the staff at Eagle Jump are a little worried about their weight. How will they get their daily exercise when their work involves sitting at a desk all day?

6.o: Aoba finishes her project of modeling villagers and gets a new one. Her next project is to design and model a character. Seeing Aoba struggling with the design, Ko gives her helpful advice. At the team leader meeting, Ko and Rin find out that they are a little bit behind schedule. It looks like the character team will have to stay some nights and come in on the weekends to catch up.

7.t: Please Train the New Hires Properly
7.o: Aoba Suzukaze thought she was done with the villager project. However, Umiko Ahagon comes to her with some problems. The models she designed are filled with errors, and no one at her department told her about it. Umiko shows frustration toward Aoba, but more so toward her supervisor, Ko Yagami.

8.o: It's summer break for Nene Sakura, aka Nenecchi, but Aoba Suzukaze isn't getting any break from work as the game's closing date draws near. In fact, Eagle Jump is looking for part-timers to help out with the debugging, and Nenecchi may have something to say about that.

9.t: Do We Have To Come Into Work?
9.o: Nenecchi is still at Eagle Jump to help out with debugging. She discovers a way to see the characters' panty shots, so the director adds panty shots to the specs. Alas, this creates more work for Aoba's team that has to fix some models' underwear.

10.t: Full-time Employment is a Loophole in the Law to Make Wages Lower
10.o: The donut store near the Eagle Jump office is having a store-wide 50% off sale. So naturally, everyone shows up to office with boxes of donuts, and it's time for a donut party.

11.t: There Were Leaked Pictures of the Game on the Internet Yesterday!
11.o: The deadline for the game is right around the corner, so everyone at the company is staying over night after night to meet the tight schedule. However, Ko Yagami recommends Aoba, Hajime, and Yun to go to the Tokyo Game Exhibit during work hours. What is she thinking?

12.t: One of My Dreams Came True!
12.o: Fairies Story 3, the game everyone's been working on, goes out to the public. The sales are looking good, and Eagle Jump is hosting a celebration party for everyone who was involved.

1.t: Of All the Embarrassing Things to Be Caught Doing...
1.o: It's been a year since Aoba joined Eagle Jump, so she's looking forward to being a senpai this year ... Umiko makes a proposal for Shizuku.

2.t: This Is Just Turning into Cos-purr-lay!
2.o: The character design competition gets announced at their flower viewing. Just like Ko’s designs for “Fairies’ Stories” was chosen right after she had joined the company after graduating high school, everyone has a chance to enter. Aoba reads the proposal that Shizuku and the other members of the design team comes up with, and ends up going through a lot of trial and error. Aoba can’t seem to get the designs just right. She goes to visit Ko and sees that she has already completed numerous sketches that are all high quality and Aoba is amazed. Aoba uses her feelings of frustration from this to t

3.o: Aoba’s dream of becoming a character designer comes true, though she has to touch up on the designs with Ko, and has to get everything finalized by Ko. Aoba sees that her designs that won at the character design competition had already been made into 3D by Hifumi, and she tells Hifumi to ask her if she has any questions about the designs. Ko warns Aoba to hurry up and keep working on the designs, but when she sees her senpais discussing something about 3D, she is unable to voice her own opinions. Aoba then starts wondering if it’s actually okay for her to be character designer...

4.o: "Moon Ranger" started off as a girls' anime series, but because of its high quality, it was highly regarded by adults and was made into theatrical releases as well as live shows. After it's two and a half year run, the protagonist in the "Moon Ranger" series was going to change. And because of that, a final live show was going to take place. Hajime, a huge "Moon Ranger" fan, wants to do anything possible to get her hands on the tickets and tries to get into the ticket site, but...

5.o: Hifumi is now the character team leader and uses all of her courage to ask Aoba and Yun about their progress on their 3D models. Both Aoba and Yun are used to Kou being the leader, and end up lying about their deadlines. However, Hifumi doesn't seem to suspect anything from their deadlines, which makes Aoba panic and tell her the truth. Meanwhile, Yun knew she wouldn't make it in time, but ended up telling Hifumi she would, ends up being even later than she thought. This makes her stress, wondering if Hifumi would become depressed once she tells her...

6.o: Things are going well for Aoba and her job as the character designer, as her desk piles up with a ton of prints that need to be checked or redone. Seeing the giant pile of papers on her desk, Aoba can't help but smile, as it confirms the fact that she is actually doing her dream job. Yun and Hajime start talking about the key visuals for the game that'll appear in gaming magazines, and Kou tells Aoba that as the character designer, she'd be in charge of doing those as well. After realizing that, Aoba starts to get nervous, but...

7.t: I'm Sensing a Very Intense Gaze
7.o: Aoba is asked by Umiko to sit in on an interview for a new programmer. Aoba asks Umiko if it's really okay for her to sit in on this interview, since she knows nothing about programming, but Umiko tells her that the skills of the programmer had already been acknowledged and that she'd just like her to watch how she behaves. Aoba still doesn't fully grasp the situation, when there's a knock on the door as it slowly opens. The person on the other side happens to be someone that Aoba is rather familiar with...

8.t: I'm Telling You, I Want a Maid Café
8.o: As Aoba, Hajime, and Yun struggle with picking out a restaurant for the new hires' welcoming party, Shizuku has them practice being maids in a maid café for no real purpose. Once a restaurant is eventually picked and the party gets underway, Nene and Tsubame get to know each other while the character team try to get Momiji to loosen up around them. Later, Hifumi tries to help Momiji, who has been eating lunch by herself, open up more, encouraging her to spend more time with the rest of the team.

9.t: At Least Put a Shirt on!
9.o: While accompanying Yun and her siblings to a hero show, Hajime comes across one of her high school friends, Akki, but is too ashamed to tell her that she works in video games. Hearing that Hajime always hid her otaku hobbies from her friends, Yun shows her that she used to be a geek herself during school, changing her image once she came to Tokyo. As Nene and Tsubame are tasked with programming some mini-games, Tsubame explains how she got into programming out of wanting to make a game together with Momiji. Upon hearing that Nene just took up programming on a whim ...

10.t: It's Gonna Really Break the Immersion
10.o: Tsubame is tasked with programming a 'red light green light' style mini-game designed to Hajime's specifications. However, every time Tsubame thinks her job is done, other staff members bring up issues with the mini-game, leading Hajime to make further changes to the design document. These delays lead Hajime to feel guilty after Tsubame voices her concerns over how it might affect her evaluation. After hearing from Umiko about how the situation is tough on Hajime as well, Tsubame finally manages to complete a satisfactory revision of the mini-game.

11.o: Running into Ko and Momiji at the cafeteria, Nene learns from Momiji that Tsubame is going against her parents' wishes and will have to take over her family's inn if she fails to get into Eagle Jump. Nene then explains how Hotaru helped give Aoba the motivation to apply for her job. Just then, the programming team discovers that Tsubame's code is full of bugs, as she prioritised speed over checking it thoroughly.

12.o: At a promotional event for Peco, Ko tells Rin that she is going to France for a few years to develop a game at another company and build upon her experience, while Momiji hears from Hifumi about how Ko was picked over Aoba for the key visuals. While giving an interview on her work on the game, Ko brings Aoba up on stage to properly acknowledge her for her character designs.

1.t: Keita Amano and Chapters of the Chosen
1.o: Gaming enthusiast Amano Keita is invited by the cutest girl at school, Tendo Karen, to join the game club. The people in the club seem cool, but...

2.o: Keita takes flak for rejecting Karen's invitation to the game club. For a moment, it looks like Keita had made the entire class his enemy, but Tasuku doesn't seem to want to board that bandwagon.

3.o: Tasuku tries to set Keita up to be friends with Chiaki, another gamer. They hit it off, leading to great misery for Karen Tendo.

4.o: Karen Tendo has been out-of-it ever since Chiaki and Keita have become friends. She runs into Keita in town, and so they go on a "walk" together.

5.o: Tasuku pieces together the surprising connections between Chiaki and Keita. Chiaki and Keita, meanwhile, not even aware that they'd had those connections, discover that they have some seemingly irreconcilable differences.

6.t: Karen Tendo and Surprise "Happy End" (Gamers and Wipeout "Game Over")
6.o: Aguri and Keita discover Chiaki and Tasuku on what appears to be a date. Aguri is devastated, but both she and Tasuku decide independently to help Keita move things along with Karen.

7.t: Keita Amano and Karen's Best Entertainment
7.o: Karen invites Keita out to a date. It takes a long time.

8.t: Erogamer and Watching Mode / Gamers and Half their Life Game
8.o: The Gamers Meet-up gets together at Chiaki’s place to play a board game. The seems to reveal – or maybe even predict – something about the gang’s relationship with each other.

9.o: Having learned that, all along, Keita was the number-one fan of her games, as well as her best buddy in an MMO, Chiaki’s feelings for him become more than just a little bit complicated.

10.o: Chiaki is led to believe that Tasuku had confessed to her. With the tensions becoming overwhelming, Keita gathers the Meet-up gang to announce his intention to finally set everything straight, but he Keitas it up.

11.o: Tasuku and Karen hatch a double-date plot to try to ease apart Aguri and Keita, whose friendship they fear has the potential to become something more.

12.o: The gang heads to the hot springs. Aguri has some piercing criticisms of gamers and the gaming industry.

1.o: تدور أحداثه حول الأسر المصرية التي تنتمي للطبقة المتوسطة التي تعيش تحت خط الفقر وتعاني كثيرًا، من خلال فتاة تعيش مع والدها الذي يحال إلى المعاش، تحلم هذه الفتاة بأشياء تتحقق كما حلمت بها، منها أحلام تخص أقاربها وجيرانها، ومنها حلم شاهدت فيه والدها يعاني من مرض ويذهب للعلاج منه دون أن يخبرها.
Years after their relationship grows stagnant, Akio's father suddenly and mysteriously quits his job, and Akio hatches a plan to get him to open up.

2.o: At work, Akio looks into why so many female employees are quitting and finds a hint by helping his father with his in-game difficulties.

3.o: Trouble with a difficult client pushes Akio to the point of giving up. With his new keyboard, his father begins communicating in a surprising way.

4.o: Akio's Dad is now hooked on Final Fantasy, but his Mom is sick of missing her TV show. Akio must deal with an interpersonal conflict at work.

5.o: Akio's Dad still won't say why he quit his job, reminding Akio of his old habit of withholding information. Meanwhile, a friend offers Dad a new job.

6.o: Suspicious his dad has been hiding an illness, Akio looks through his things but finds nothing. The next day, he's given some surprising news.

7.o: With only days remaining before his Dad's big date, Akio and the team struggle to defeat Twintania in time for his planned reveal.

8.o: This special recaps Akio's plan to rekindle the bond between him and his father and closes with new content about a side character's relationship.

1.o: The warden of Shawshank Prison commits suicide, leaving behind an unsettling mystery that seems to be connected to a case from 27 years earlier.

2.o: Henry Deaver returns to Castle Rock and takes on the Kid as a client. A letter left behind by Warden Lacy sheds some light on the Kid's origins.

3.o: The past catches up with Molly Strand.

4.o: Henry urges the Kid to accept the prison's settlement and investigates his own disappearance decades earlier. A Shawshank prison guard snaps.

5.o: After the Shawshank shooting, the Kid is released and Henry moves him into an apartment above Molly's office. A ceremony honoring Alan goes awry.

6.o: Molly confesses her role in the death of Reverend Deaver. Henry's son Wendell arrives from Boston. The Kid is institutionalized, but not for long.

7.o: Ruth explains her jumbled memories and time-skipping to her grandson Wendell, but the Kid's presence and her disorientation have tragic consequences.

8.o: Out-of-towners renovate the Lacy home into a murder-themed bed and breakfast. Molly rescues Henry from the camper. Ruth remains lost in the past.

9.o: The true identity of the Kid is revealed, as well as his relationship to Henry, Molly and a site in the forest where strange sightings occur.

10.o: Henry and the Kid end up jailed together just as a prisoner transfer from the shuttering Shawshank prison leads to a violent breakout.

1.o: On the run with her daughter Joy, ex-nurse Annie Wilkes works temp jobs to steal medication. Ace Merrill threatens the Somali developer of a new mall.

2.o: Hiding evidence of her crime, Annie discovers that the new mall is being built on a cemetery. Pop Merrill's past is revealed.

3.o: Joy has a fun day out with local kids but begins to question her mother's mental state when she returns to the motel. Pop's medical condition worsens.

4.o: Ace reveals the sinister history of Jerusalem's Lot to his brother Chris. Nadia Howlwadaag learns why Pop adopted her and her brother Abdi.

5.o: Joy learns the truth about her mother's traumatic childhood and struggles with learning disabilities. Joy also discovers her own real origin.

6.o: Tracing the call she received, Rita arrives in Castle Rock and searches for Joy, while Annie desperately tries to reconnect with her daughter.

7.o: Pop begins to discover how Ace is bringing the dark history of Jerusalem's Lot back to life in the present. Annie takes the fall for Joy.

8.o: Annie and Joy take refuge at the Marsten House, where Ace is manipulating events and mesmerizing the town to contrive a long-prophesied resurrection.

9.o: Pop and the rest of the unconverted seek shelter at the Emporium Galorium, where he discovers letters that reveal information about the Angel.

10.o: Annie and her remaining unconverted allies devise a plan to blow up the Angel statue and release the townspeople from their collective trance.

1.o: Tara Khanna and Karan Mehra have landed the biggest wedding in Delhi. Angad Roshan, heir to the Roshan Cycles empire, is marrying Aliya Saxena, a journalist. For the Roshans, something is definitely amiss. Tara and Karan must investigate who Aliya really is, or there might not be a wedding at all. No better way to start the wedding season.

2.o: Harsimran Mann, a Dubai princess, is marrying Joginder Sethi, of the Sethi Hotel Group. Made In Heaven has planned for Harsimran’s favorite Bollywood superstar Sarfaraz Khan to headline the first night. With a Mann-Sethi business deal on the line, this wedding has a lot more riding on it than meets the eye. And with Sarfaraz in attendance, the bride has nothing but stars in her eyes.

3.o: Gayatri Mathur, a sixty-plus widow, is marrying Bijoy Chatterjee, a Bengali architect. It’s a distinctively sweet union that has everyone’s support except the people that matter most - her children. On the flip side, Karan’s college friend Bubbles is getting married to man that Karan knows a bit better than he would have hoped.

4.o: Priyanka Mishra is marrying Vishal Shrivastava, an IAS officer and the plan is to fund the wedding themselves. The Mishras are disappointed that they can’t splurge on their only daughter’s wedding till their in-laws find a way to change that. Can Karan and Tara balance the parents and the kids?

5.o: Sukhmani Sadana wins a contest that will determine who marries Jeet Gill, a wealthy NRI. The promise of an American life as an American wife is a big deal for a Ludhiana girl. Tara and Karan know that this isn’t a prestigious destination wedding for Made in Heaven, but one must do what is required in the given circumstances. After all, it is what it is.

6.o: Geetanjali Sinha, a Wharton graduate, is marrying Nikhil Swarup, a doctor residing in London. A wedding so straightforward couldn’t have come at a better time. That is, of course, until it turns out that Geetanjali is a manglik. Tara and Karan aren’t in the best space to negotiate between superstition and logic.

7.o: Samar Ranawat, a Rajput prince, is marrying Devyani Singh, a pilot making her the first working woman in the royal household. A lavish celebration of progress and woman empowerment is interrupted when a mehendiwali is sexually assaulted during an event. Tara and Karan need to get the girl justice while making sure the show goes on.

8.o: Tarana Ali is getting married and is using the opportunity to make a music video for herself. Her father has gone into debt. On the flip side, the peon at the Made In Heaven office is bailed out by Tara and Karan from taking a loan to fund his daughter’s wedding. Rich or poor, nothing seems to be more important to a man’s ego than how he gets daughter married.

9.o: Political party leader Brajesh Yadav’s daughter, Nutan Yadav is marrying Vishal Singh, a man groomed to be the next prime minister. Everyone knows this wedding is merely a front for the political coalition but when Tara and Karan uncover a harsh truth, they must decide between their principles and their business.

1.t: Long Story Short … A Bear Ripped My C**k Off and Ate It
1.o: Back in jail, tripping on mushrooms and transformed into cartoons, the boys test the limits of their new reality with both fear and excitement.

2.o: A tapeworm is taking the grub right out of Ricky's mouth, but when the parasite swipes his weed, that's the last straw. Bubbles connects at the club.

3.o: Bubbles convinces Julian and Ricky to join him as he stalks Wayne Gretzky. Now they must beat the Moncton Mudslides to win back the Stanley Bong.

4.o: The boys go on a mission to save a mountain lion friend, but they don't count on the mosquitoes, bear traps or sperm-harvesting backwoods locals.

5.o: Business booms -- and chaos reigns -- as Julian revs up a sexy car wash, Ricky opens a trailer pool, and Bubbles goes it alone to build his dream shed.

6.o: Old-school hash brings back memories of grade school, when young Julian, Ricky and Bubbles met, smoked and retaliated against a bully with a pellet gun.

7.o: Trinity and Jacob want to move, so the boys deliver hash to raise cash. But Ricky gets greedy and incurs the wrath of a rampaging biker gang.

8.o: When Ricky's grow operations are exposed, an entrepreneur approaches him to cultivate dope in space. Beyond pumped, Bubbles demands to join the team.

9.o: To get off the grid, Ricky liberates hundreds of car batteries. Julian concocts a scheme to ride out a big storm, but Mother Nature has other plans.

10.o: The boys throw a benefit concert featuring Helix to save Sunnyvale. But how can their event compete with the nearby Queens of the Stone Age show?

1.o: Hoping to pass the IIT entrance exams, teen Vaibhav arrives in Kota with one goal: to nab a seat at the best coaching center in the city.

2.o: Canteen food, insomnia and studying weigh on Vaibhav, but when his friends’ tips don’t help, Professor Jeetu offers his campus-life survival strategies.

3.o: Struggling with Inorganic Chemistry, Vaibhav plots to have his instructor replaced, but his problem with the subject may not be the person teaching it.

4.o: Given several days off before exams begin, Vaibhav, Meena and Uday each use the revision period to pursue romantic possibilities, with mixed results.

5.o: Standing at a crossroads in his academic journey, Vaibhav is torn between his heart and his mind before making a big decision about his next steps.

1.o: With their new classes off to a bleak start, Vaibhav and his peers question the value of the IIT dream and seek inspiration from a trusted source.

2.o: Struggling with Physics, Vaibhav attempts to bend the rules to attend Jeetu’s classes. Meena frets that teenage hormones will get the best of him.

3.o: Jeetu searches for staff for his institute, making some reluctant choices along the way. Filled with self-doubt, Vartika evades practice tests at Aimers.

4.o: When a bout of jaundice slows Vaibhav down in his studying, Jeetu insists he calls his only hope to get well quickly: his mother.

5.o: JEE results send Kota into celebration mode and give Vaibhav, Meena and Uday glimpses into their own futures, but the occasion comes with sad truths.

1.o: Jeetu struggles to cope with the loss of a student. Vaibhav doubts his own path to success when his cricket-playing cousin visits Kota.

2.o: Facing financial stress, Meena begins tutoring an eager student to earn extra cash. Vaibhav's attitude forces Vartika to find a new study partner.

3.o: A clash with Gagan causes Jeetu to spiral. Shivangi feels the strain of the NEET prep, while Vaibhav and Meena compete for ranks in a test series.

4.o: Jeetu receives an offer that affects the future of Aimers. Uday’s error in judgment leads to serious trouble. Exam pressure takes its toll on Vaibhav.

5.o: Prayers and prep take hold as the final countdown to the exam approaches. Jeetu makes a startling announcement to his students.

1.o: Energetic singer-dancer Mia auditions for Saint Mary, a fancy boarding school with a performing arts department. Popular Lupe likes her instantly.
Convinced by her friend Risa to try "NewWorld Online", Kaede begins her VRMMO adventure by going all-in on defense because she doesn't want to get hurt.

2.o: Maple enters a battle royal and is hunted down by a horde of players. Risa uses her swimming talent to explore an underwater cave with her character Sally.

3.o: After Maple gets nerfed, her and Sally do some exploring before challenging the dungeon that leads to the second level. Can they clear it in time for the second event?

4.o: Though Maple and Sally get off to a clumsy start in the second event, their tenacity and teamwork is rewarded in more ways than one.

5.o: Maple and Sally make new friends and fall into more trouble as the second event winds down. But to reach their goal of 20 medals, they may have to resort to PvP.

6.o: Maple leaps at the chance to create a guild and searches for a place to call home. But to compete in the upcoming event, they'll need to recruit more help.

7.o: Everyone in the guild is hard at work leveling up and preparing for what's to come. Maple manages to "cheese" her way through a quest to help a sick NPC.

8.o: The third event is packed with people making it hard to compete for cowbells. Following the event, Maple gets into gear to explore new content on the third level.

9.o: Guilds prepare for all-out war as the big competition finally begins. But sneaky Sally has some tricks up her sleeve that hopefully gives them the upper hand.

10.o: Sally faces certain death and there's trouble back at the base. Despite having a good start, if the guild hopes to place top ten, Maple Tree must go on the attack.

11.o: Maple Tree is vastly outnumbered and struggles to stay on the board. As guilds get wiped out left and right, they must face a mighty foe that may be their undoing.

12.o: Maple may have maxed out her defense, but can she protect her friends and base from a legendary player? This time, Maple may have met her match.

1.o: As Christmas draws near, New World Online finally releases Level 4 concurrently with a special holiday event in which rare and exclusive items are at stake.

2.o: Maple's guildmates must explore Level 5 without her while she recovers from a cold. Right after Maple finally gets a chance to see Level 5, the gang finds out that Level 6 is already on the way, but this time it's Sally who can't seem to go in...

3.t: Maxing Defense and the Seventh Event
3.o: New World Online's seventh event begins, and it's a battle tower event with multiple difficulty levels. Maple and Sally team up to take on the highest difficulty level, giving the game's admins more than they bargained for...

4.o: Maple and Sally continue to work their way up the ten floors of the tower as they attempt to complete the event before anyone else.

5.o: Level 7 has been released, and it introduces a new feature: players can now tame monsters. The members of Maple Tree explore the new level in search of their ideal companions.

6.o: The members of Maple Tree continue their searches for monster companions. Iz's search leads her on a quest to find rare materials in challenging areas, so she asks Maple and Mii for help.

7.t: Maxing Defense and Hunting for Crystals
7.o: With the eighth event about to start, Maple and Sally decide to leisurely explore Level 7. Their plans quickly change when they stumble upon a strange crystal...

8.t: Maxing Defense and the Eighth Event
8.o: The preliminary round of the eighth event finally begins. The members of Maple Tree fight their hardest, making the most of their new monster companions, in hopes of ranking high for the main event.

9.t: Maxing Defense and Setting Up a Base
9.o: The main portion of the eighth event begins. The members of Maple Tree work as two teams to try to acquire medals, then come back together to set up a base for protection against the stronger monsters that come out at night.

10.o: The second day of the eighth event begins with forced teleports that send players in all directions, a dark void that swallows up some parties' bases, and the disabling of maps. On top of all this, those who survived the first night are left to fight either alone or with members of rival guilds.

11.o: Maple Tree, Order of the Holy Sword, and Flame Emperors have all come together in Maple Tree's base. Assorted members from all three guilds form parties to head out and fight monsters so they can earn more medals during the second night of the event.

12.t: Maxing Defense and the Big Final Battle
12.o: The third and final day of the eighth event brings the strongest monsters yet. Maple Tree, Flame Emperors, and Order of the Holy Sword work together to fight off the final onslaught. The goal is to make it to the end of the event alive...

1.ar: الفصل الأول: الفتى في الجبل الجليدي
1.o: blings (سوكا وكتارا) يكتشف مراهقان يعيشان في القطب الجنوبي صبيًا غريبًا جدًا (Aang) ، جنبًا إلى جنب مع حيوانه الأليف الذي يطير البيسون آبا ، في جبل جليدي.  لكن هل يمكنهم الوثوق به عندما يوجه الحرب بطريق الخطأ إلى عتبة قريتهم؟

2.o: يكتشفا  كاتارا و سوكا أن آنج هو الافاتار المفقود منذ زمن طويل ويجب أن ينقذه عندما يخطفه أمير شارد يُدعى زوكو

3.o: آنج ‎متحمس للعودة إلى المنزل (معبد الهواء الجنوبي) لأول مرة منذ مائة عام ، لكنه صُدم عندما اكتشف أن المعبد مهجور.  يخبر آنج  سوكا وكتارا عن طفولته أثناء استكشافهما للمعبد ، لكن سرعان ما يكتشفان شيئًا لم يتوقعه آنج  أبدًا.  في هذه الأثناء ، يجب على الأمير زوكو إجراء إصلاحات لسفينته والطريقة الوحيدة التي يمكنه بها القيام بذلك هي إرساء سفينته في القاعدة البحرية لمنافسه.

4.o: تصل العصابة إلى جزيرة كيوشي ويلتقطها بعض محاربي كيوشي.  عندما يكشف Aang أنه الصورة الرمزية ، تنتشر الأخبار بسرعة وتصل فجأة إلى الأمير Zuko الذي يذهب بعد ذلك إلى جزيرة Kyoshi للقبض عليه.

5.o: Aang's abilities as an airbender are challenged by a strange king.

6.o: In a nearby Earth Village, the gang meets a teenage earthbender named Haru. This village lives in fear of the Fire Nation, for soldiers there capture any earthbenders they can find. After Haru is captured for earthbending, Katara is compelled to rescue him.

7.o: Aang and friends visit a village being terrorized by an angry spirit. Iroh is captured by Earth Kingdom soldiers.

8.o: To contact the spirit of the previous Avatar, Aang must reach a temple in the Fire Nation before the sun sets on the following day. There he will learn what he must do to restore balance to the world. Zuko must defy his banishment to follow Aang.

9.o: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, but realizes that he is learning it much faster than she is, she is desperate to improve her abilities.  When Katara inadvertently stumbles across a waterbending scroll that can help improve her abilities at a pirate’s store, she decides to steal it, realizing that she couldn’t hope to afford it.

1.t: The Murder Case From Five Years Ago
1.o: On their first day as partners, detectives Kang Do-chang and Oh Ji-hyeok pick up a series of calls with perplexing connections to a closed murder case.

2.t: No Sinner Shall Sleep Peacefully At Night
2.o: Words get out of Incheon Seobu Police Station revealing that Lee Eun Hye, the daughter of a murderer Lee Dae Chul, has been kidnapped, murdered, and buried by a man who claims to be the culprit. As the news goes viral, people who were related to the murder case from five years ago tremble in fear of possibilities of getting brought to justice.

3.o: The execution of death-row convict Lee Dae Chul nears as well as the evaluation for Do Chang’s promotion. Knowing that Lee Dae Chul has an alibi at the time of the murder, Do Chang needs to decide whether to save an innocent man or to submit to the authority. Meanwhile, Do Chang and Ji Hyuk are joined by Seo Gyeong at Dae Chul’s old workplace, and that’s when Seo Gyeong gets a phone call from Park Gun Ho, who seemed to sound very urgent.

4.o: A big body of corruption sweeps over Violent Crimes Unit Two with the higher-ups continuously pressuring them to turn a blind eye to Lee Dae Chul’s case. Meanwhile, Ji Hyuk saves Seo Gyeong from Jo Seong Dae who is suspected of killing Park Gun Ho. Eventually, clues that lead to Lee Dae Chul’s innocence start piling up as Do Chang decides to look into the case to clarify discomforting ambiguities.

5.t: We Are Trying To Save A Person’s Life
5.o: While clues proving a corruptive body’s close relation to Lee Dae Chul’s case pile up, Do Chang figures out a work-around to carry out a secret investigation on Jo Seong Dae. On top of that, Ji Hyuk hints to him how his very cousin, Oh Jong Tae, may be partially responsible for Yoon Ji Sun’s death from five years ago. Meanwhile, Dae Chul’s day of execution nears as his daughter, Eun Hye, visits him at the prison.

6.o: Do Chang confesses to Eun Hye that he wants to save her father, Lee Dae Chul. Unfortunately, Eun Hye can’t trust Do Chang who literally handcuffed and arrested her father for a murder he didn’t commit. However, Do Chang shows a sign of hope for Eun Hye by getting the re-trial approved. Meanwhile, Superintendent Moon and Yoon Sang Mi prepare themselves for the possibility of an unexpected turn of events.

7.t: Every Truth Has Two Opposing Stories
7.o: Although Do Chang and Mr. So prepare for the retrial of Lee Dae Chul’s case, Do Chang still needs to persuade Dae Chul to follow his lead because he is reluctant to take part in it due to the possibility of harm that it may cause his daughter. Meanwhile, Do Chang finds himself caught in a dilemma that is inflicting harm to both the victims who lost their beloved partners and the ones who crossed the line for their greed.

8.t: Do Chang on a Witness Stand
8.o: It was already difficult enough for Do Chang and others to get a retrial approved. However, feeling desperate during the trial, Dae Chul falsely admits to his killing of Detective Jang Jin Soo. Meanwhile, Seo Gyeong receives a recording from an unknown sender of a conversation between Superintendent Moon and a prosecutor, which could act as solid evidence to prove Dae Chul’s innocence.

9.t: A Voice Recording of Superintendent Moon
9.o: After losing at the retrial, Do Chang gets demoted. With Do Chang out of the picture, Violent Crimes Unit Two also feels pointless to even fight for a comeback. Meanwhile, Ji Hyuk meets Seo Gyeong and finds out about a voice recording that she’s been keeping secret. Ji Hyuk and Do Chang then indirectly threaten Superintendent Moon so that they can follow him and see where he would lead them.

10.t: The One Behind Jo Seong Dae
10.o: Do Chang gets reinstated and returns to Violent Crimes Unit Two after coming to an agreement with Superintendent Moon. The team then focuses on Park Gun Ho’s case and stumbles upon Jo Seong Dae’s bloodstain at the murder site. This leads to the revelation of Chief Nam's wrongdoing as well as a possible connection to Oh Jong Tae. Just before closing in on Jo Seong Dae, the team catches the sight of the one behind the corruption.

11.t: Do Chang Goes After Oh Jong Tae
11.o: With the help of a little stunt pulled off by Jae Hong, Do Chang gets one step closer to proving Oh Jong Tae’s crime. Meanwhile, Ji Hyuk barges into Yoo Jeong Seok’s office, asking if he is closely acquainted with his cousin, Oh Jong Tae. Even with all evidence closing in on him, Oh Jong Tae still holds what seems to be the key to shaking off all things that annoy him.

12.o: While Ji Hyuk manages to survive the ambush by Oh Jong Tae, the prosecution adds more pressure to Do Chang and his colleagues, invalidating their efforts to bring Oh Jong Tae down. Do Chang however continues to put pieces together and stumbles upon a crucial link that connects Oh Jong Tae to his evil deed. Meanwhile, Seo Gyeong finds out that her boss, Yoo Jeong Seok, was at the murder scene five years ago.

13.t: The Remains Of A Dead Body Near Gawol Church
13.o: Jin Seo Gyeong hosts a secret meeting with Yoo Jeong Seok and Kim Gi Tae at Gawol Church, demanding them the truth regarding a missing person named Jo Seong Gi. In the meantime, Do Chang and Ji Hyuk successfully locate the missing dead body from five years ago. Despite the evidence against their favor, Oh Jong Tae and Nam Guk Hyun cook up a loophole to clear the charges.

14.o: Even after the arrest, Oh Jong Tae still has the audacity to claim his innocence and goes on to emphasize the incompetence and corruption of the police organization. Meanwhile, Seo Gyeong and Sang Mi sidestep to approach the matter in their own way. Eventually, Do Chang reaches Yoo Jeong Seok with a warrant, and Jeong Seok shocks everyone by uttering a short confession.

15.o: Yoo Jeong Seok admits to his doings before his junior reporters and leaves the office, ordering them to stay put until his next instruction. While being threatened by Oh Jong Tae, Nam Guk Hyun offers video footage of Jeong Seok’s murders. On the verge of being exposed, Jeong Seok willingly suggests the police that he would confess in his unique manner. The confession is officially published.

16.o: The shocking death of Yoo Jeong Seok stirs up the public, and the case is now under a spotlight. As the prosecutor makes a confession to his previous wrongdoing out of conscience, Oh Jong Tae gets sentenced to a lifetime in prison. However, Ji Hyuk’s gut feeling tingles down his back, and he starts searching for something. Something that might just reveal the truth behind the death of a fellow detective, Jang Joon Gi.

1.o: A serial killer is on the loose. As Do-chang battles past trauma, the investigation grows murkier, only taking him further from the truth.

2.o: Do-chang’s guilt grows after another unexpected death takes place. Others want to wrap up the case, but Do-chang and Ji-hyeok refuse to give up.

3.o: The detectives find some strong evidence and start going over CCTV footage. A man burns mysterious objects, and makes a suspicious approach.

4.o: Do-chang and Ji-hyeok are hot on the killer’s heels, but elsewhere another murder is underway. Cheon Sang-u keeps an eye on Cheon Na-na.

5.o: Do-chang finds out about the killer’s tragic past and realizes that one piece of his pattern of murders doesn’t line up. He induces a confession.

6.o: Na-na follows Sang-u and finds some evidence. The team is threatened with being broken up. The detectives investigate Jung Hui-ju’s acquaintances.

7.o: Kim Min-ji’s background is revealed. The detectives get proof that incriminates TJ Group executives. Ji-hyeok is curious about Na-na’s intentions.

8.o: Na-na’s press conference throws Woo Tae-ho into disarray. A suspect in the Hui-ju case is caught and some clarity is brought to the case.

9.o: The detectives question Na-na about the car accident. They investigate Tae-ho's previous whereabouts, but Choi Yong-geun is looking into this too.

10.o: Na-na preys on Sang-u’s weaknesses. A mysterious man follows Moon Bo-kyeong, while Yong-geun plans to use her connections to his advantage.

11.o: Yong-geun is arrested, but uses his experience to make the interrogation difficult. The detectives search for a motive for Sang-u’s murder.

12.o: Sang-u is furious after realizing that Na-na came close to turning him in. Ji-hyeok provokes Yong-geun in an attempt to make Sang-u culpable.

13.o: The detectives ask to reopen Tae-ho’s case and look for further evidence regarding his death. Na-na asks Ji-hyeok to make an allegiance with her.

14.o: The detectives question the gang who tried to kill Hui-ju’s grandfather. As they get closer to the truth, Na-na and Jang Ki-jin get into trouble.

15.o: Na-na passes evidence of her father threatening her to Ji-hyeok, but he uses it against her. Ki-jin files a false charge against Do-chang’s team.

16.o: While the detectives search for proof of Na-na’s crimes, she becomes chairman of TJ Group. Ji-hyeok gives testimony to get Sang-u released.

1.o: This is the country Hinomoto. Thanks to revolutionary new technologies, the country flourished and the economy boomed. However, overshadowed by those advances, the railroad was losing significance and drifted into obscurity. There are beings called Railord. They are humanoid or doll-like control modules for railroad trains and are responsible for assisting with the safe operation of the railroad. Time passes and it is now the year 1989, Ohitoyo City in Kyuushuu's Kumamoto prefecture...
