3.o: تدخل إيو وريكو في أوّل جلسة فرعية لمناقشة البضائع، وتقترح ريكو فكرةً مرتبطة بالمعبد على خطّ سكّتها بينما تشمئز إيو من الحشرات

4.o: Suzushiro, Iyo, and Riiko are in deep discussions about what merchandise to produce. But the insect lover Riiko is too distracted as she wants to go look for bugs...

5.o: The second breakout session has begun. Beni is psyched because she wants to win against Reina. On the other hand, finished with their session, Iyo and Riiko are checking out Ohitoyo City's sights!

6.o: When it's Beni's turn to come up with an idea for merchandise, she has a spark of inspiration! Meanwhile, Shirogane and Ran get almost too excited while visiting a local train souvenir shop...

7.o: Breakout session #3 begins. First up is Ran, an extremely popular Raillord, nicknamed "Prince of Raillords"! Meanwhile Kiko and Beni, who are done with their session, make their way to a blacksmith.

8.t: The One Who Travels Through Tunnels
8.o: In order to bring about a new era of the railroad, Ran and Shirogane continue working on merch ideas. Meanwhile, Kakaa and Suika's sightseeing takes them to Ohitoyo City's castle.

9.o: Having finished their sightseeing trip around Ohitoyo City, the last merch breakout session with Kakaa and Suika begins. Meanwhile, having finished theirs, Ran and Shirogane go visit the coal mine...

10.o: The Raillords are now in the final stages of coming up with merchandise ideas.

11.o: The Raillords' breakout sessions, meant to bring about a new age of the railroad, have finished without incident. After that, all of the Raillords go and...

12.o: The Raillord Summit has been successfully concluded. To wrap things up, the Raillords all go out one last time to promote the upcoming Maitetsu Festival.

1.o: Tiny, invisible people threaten Hilda's fun and adventurous life in the wilderness with her mother and pet deer-fox, Twig.

2.o: Hilda reaches out to a sad and lonely giant while her mum, worried about the threats they've received, mulls over a move to the city of Trolberg.

3.o: Encouraged by her mother to make new friends on the playground, Hilda instead buddies up to an injured bird who's lost his memory.

4.o: After joining the Sparrow Scouts, Hilda partners with new pals Frida and David to clean up a park, little realizing what's lurking underground.

5.o: On parent-teacher night, Hilda springs into action when she discovers David's pet rock project hides a dangerous secret.

6.o: When David blames his nightmares on Hilda and her hair-raising exploits, she decides to try and help him face his fears.

7.o: On a quest to earn their Sparrow Scouts botany badges, Hilda, David and Frida make a surprising discovery when they search for a rare plant.

8.o: Hilda realizes the importance of being detail-oriented when she casts a spell from a book of enchantments -- and fails to read the fine print.

9.o: Frida's messy room and missing book lead the gang on a ghost hunt that ends up putting their growing friendship to the test.

10.o: When her favorite radio weather reporter goes silent amid a raging blizzard, Hilda decides to investigate, with David and the Raven in tow.

11.t: Chapter 11: The House in the Woods
11.o: Alone and lost in the wilderness, Hilda bumps into an old friend and asks for help getting home. Back in Trolberg, her worried mum looks for her.

12.o: On the eve of an overnight camping trip, Hilda tries to help a down-and-out house spirit. Frida makes new friends. A mysterious beast prowls Trolberg.

13.o: As fear grips the city over the Black Hound, Hilda makes it her mission to help Tontu, even if it means having less time to earn Sparrow Scout badges.

1.o: Hilda's essay about her close encounter with a troll wins her the chance to tag along with Trolberg's new head of the safety patrol, Erik Ahlberg.

2.o: A quest to uncover secret information about Ahlberg leads Hilda on a high-seas adventure with the Wood Man that lands them in a boatload of trouble.

3.o: After Hilda and Frida come across a magical portal at the library, they must team up with the librarian in a race against time to find a missing book.

4.o: David confronts his many fears when he stumbles into a ferocious battle during an overnight Sparrow Scouts camping trip with Hilda and Frida.

5.o: On a bird-watching expedition, Hilda, Frida and David run into meteorologist Victoria Van Gale, whose calm new life makes one of them very suspicious.

6.t: Chapter 6: The Old Bells of Trolberg
6.o: Chaos comes to Trolberg when the bell system begins to ring every hour, inspiring Hilda and friends to hatch an elaborate scheme to quiet the noise.

7.t: Chapter 7: The Beast of Cauldron Island
7.o: Hilda and Frida launch an in-depth investigation to prove the fire-breathing resident of Cauldron Island isn't responsible for a wave of boat attacks.

8.o: Hilda learns all too well that actions have consequences after she discovers a way to travel back in time — and decides to make a few changes.

9.o: After Hilda's deer-fox companion Twig leaves home and runs into the wilderness, Hilda and her mum set off on a search that stirs bittersweet memories.

10.o: On their way to Trolberg's Winter Festival, Hilda, Frida and David come across a group of odd little fellows who are on the hunt for naughty kids.

11.o: Hilda and pals gear up for a magical mission: to reverse an enchantment that's taken over the headquarters of the local snack food company, Jorts.

12.o: Desperate times call for desperate measures as Alfur faces questions from the Elf Kingdom over his exciting reports from Trolberg.

13.o: Hilda, her mum and Twig look for a way out of a mysterious forest full of trolls, while a worried David and Frida journey out of Trolberg to find them.

1.o: Hilda and the gang take the train to Tofoten to visit Great-Aunt Astrid for a relaxing holiday — but adventure soon comes knocking at their door.

2.o: Convinced that fairies exist in Tofoten, Hilda starts investigating around town... only to uncover a troubling mystery involving her own family.

3.o: An ancient Faratok Tree transports Hilda and Wood Man to an alternate universe, where a feud rages between giants and a not-so-mighty giantslayer.

4.o: After their fellow Sparrow Scouts dub them "The Freaky Friends," Hilda, Frida and David resolve to have the most ordinary river trip imaginable.

5.o: When Hilda's father comes for a surprise visit, she joins him on a mysterious errand to the castle ruins on behalf of a shady man known as "The Polecat."

6.o: Hilda and her mother go on a camping trip, but Johanna suspects she's visited this forest before. Does the forest remember her, too?

7.o: Frida holds a town hall meeting to figure out why the nisse keep stealing from each other while Hilda tries to decode her radio's cryptic messages.

8.o: Hilda journeys into the fairy mound to look for her father, unraveling surprising family secrets along the way — but the truth comes at a great risk.

1.o: Kohachi Inugami, a detective specializing in supernatural matters, is hired to investigate some animal mutilations in a rural village. His investigation leads to an unusual boy, nicknamed “Dorotabo,” who is ostracized by the other villagers.

2.o: Kabane meets Akira and Shiki, two other Kemono who work for Inugami, and he and Shiki get off to a rocky start. The office is called out to deal with an incident where a mother and her son are set upon by a supernatural infestation in their home.

3.o: Superintendent Inari of the Shinjuku Police Station, a kitsune Kemono herself, asks Kabane to come to her station to introduce himself. But when Inari asks to see his lifestone, it becomes evident that she has an ulterior motive for the visit.

4.o: The office members help a love-stricken client track down the object of his affection, and Kabane learns a lesson about love. Akira decides to pattern himself after Kabane, and the two are assigned to investigate a deadly case on the Shibuya River.

5.o: A longtime acquaintance of Inugami, the vampire Mihai, has been staying at the office. Kabane and the others unexpectedly end up in an arm-wrestling competition with him, but are outclassed by the extraordinary vampiric power that he possesses.

6.o: Kabane, Shiki and Akira embark on a dangerous mission set up by Mihai, breaking into a company controlled by a trio of kanonba (mosquito Kemono) sisters to investigate it. When discovered, they must fight it out, but something comes over Shiki.

7.o: In search of a lead on Shiki’s parents, Kabane and the others head to his hometown of Kinshigo, where they meet up with his uncle, Akio Tademaru. The others don’t know what to say to Shiki when he learns about his parents, but then Nobimaru turns up.

8.o: Shiki corners the man who tormented his mother. However, at the last moment, he is attacked by a pack of Kemono and finds himself in a pinch. Separated from Inugami, Kabane and Shiki are surrounded, and must confront the pack of Kemono themselves.

9.o: Kabane and company leave Shiki and his family in the care of Ohana-basan, a vet who also sees Kemono patients, and return to the office, where they head out on a new case—parts of women’s faces are being stolen, and Kon ends up tagging along as well.

10.o: When Akira runs away from the office over a trivial dispute, he unexpectedly bumps into his long-lost brother, Yui. Akira is delighted, but Yui behaves strangely, as little by little, the events of the past in their snowy home village are unraveled.

11.o: Kabane and the others try to bring Akira home from the ice castle, but are stopped by the power of Yui’s nullstone, and Akira is overcome with shock at the turn of events. Meanwhile, Inari and Nobimaru secretly go into action to claim the nullstone.

12.o: Nobimaru has a tough battle against Yui, who is using the power of the nullstone, until Kabane leaps in to help him. Kabane uses Nobimaru’s tactic and gives his all to beat Yui’s freezing power, as the battle over the nullstone finally reaches its climax!

1.o: Salma suffers from the recklessness of her husband, the multiplicity of his whims and his female relationships, which causes disagreements and problems between them permanently.
Two rival families become entangled in a bitter feud, caught up in local life, addiction, corruption, with their children tragically caught in the crossfire

In the early 1990s in the fictitious town of San Gregorio, Mexico, Dani, a high-school senior, forms an unlikely alliance with Victoria, Olivia and Tamara to find out what happened to Lorena, who has mysteriously disappeared.

2.o: Dani doesn't buy the official version of what happened at the library, so she convinces the other girls to do their own research on it. Olivia transcribes Lorena's diary and is worried by what she finds.

3.o: The girls find out that Lorena was studying them, and that she thought they all had special abilities. When it comes to Dani, though, she's still a mystery.

4.o: Dani thinks they were brainwashed by the VHS tape they rented. She and Tamara attempt to show this tape to Olivia and Victoria to prove it, but the tape turns out to be way more dangerous than they thought.

5.o: Dani, Tamara, Victoria and Olivia escape the town's party to investigate what's behind Victoria's family's car assembler mysterious wall. What they find will change the course of their lives forever.

1.o: Duff gets help from his friends to make homemade pasta and sauces.

2.o: Duff and his friends try to lure a chocolate unicorn out of hiding.

3.o: To save the planet from hungry aliens, Duff bakes the Best Bread on Earth.

4.o: Duff and the crew wonder what will happen if they bake a cake without eggs.

5.o: Duff and his friends cool the Dragon Oven's fiery hiccups with ice cream.

6.o: Duff and his friends can't choose between salty and sweet snacks.

1.o: Dong Sik, a stock analyst at Daehan Securities, takes the blame for a report he didn’t write that caused a leading pharmaceutical company’s stock price to fall. He decides to end his life and attempts to jump. However, a murder about to happen catches his eye.

2.o: After the restroom incident with Mr. Gong, Dong Sik becomes jubilant. His world of being a pushover ends, and he begins to believe that he is indeed a predator. Meanwhile, Seo In Woo, the serial killer, starts to look for his missing diary, and Shim Bo Kyung, a patrol officer, discovers something strange in the violent crimes and attempts to find the homeless man who vanished.

3.o: Dong Sik determines to kill Seo Ji Hoon and secretly plans how he's going to do it. In Woo tells Dong Sik about a company going public and urges him to buy as many shares as he can. Meanwhile, Ji Hoon and Chan Suk resort to the old-fashioned way to get rid of Dong Sik, and Bo Kyung goes on a suspicious call.

4.t: You and I Are the Same
4.o: In Woo tries to get close with Dong Sik after secretly following him and seeing him kidnap Ji Hoon. In Woo becomes the director of the Asset Management Team and promotes Dong Sik to assistant manager. Dong Sik later finds out that he had written a suicide note on the day of killing the homeless man and is thrown into confusion. Meanwhile, Bo Kyung, who is after the serial killer, starts to find Dong Sik's behavior strangely suspicious.

5.o: Bo Kyung and In Woo both chase after Dong Sik for different reasons. And soon, both get closer to what they are after. Bo Kyung gets an unexpected hint from Dong Sik about the serial murders and starts to investigate a missing person case. Meanwhile, In Woo starts to become more active.

6.o: Dong Sik wants to stop Bo Kyung from looking into the murder case happened at Goseong Chemical, so he follows her and offers help. Dong Sik gets to know Nergui by chance when he sneaks into Goseong Chemical. Nergui asks for Dong Sik’s help and tells him that Jin Goo doesn’t kill himself. Meanwhile, an open investigation begins after a dead body is found in Goseong Chemical, and In Woo finds out that Dong Sik and Bo Kyung actually know each other.

7.o: Another death made to look like a suicide arises and puts Dong Sik and In Woo on edge. According to the victim's husband's statement and with a composite sketch of the killer, Bo Kyung and the Predator Killings Task Force head out in search of the suspect. Later, someone claiming to be the serial killer calls a broadcasting network.

8.o: Being the last person talking to Sung Chul, Dong Sik tells the police that Sung Chul is the predatory killer they are after. The team decided to close the case although Bo Kyung believes that he could be just a copycat killer, and the real predator still hasn’t been caught. Meanwhile, In Woo learns the truth that Dong Sik is suffered from amnesia due to the accident.

9.o: Dong Sik and Bo Kyung try to uncover the truth of a murder that happened eight years ago. As the two visit the crime scene, Dong Sik tries to convince himself that it wasn't him. Meanwhile, In Woo plans to set Dong Sik up as the killer to all his past murders, and Bo Kyung receives an anonymous text message about the predatory serial killer.

10.o: In Woo has Dong Sik right where he wants him. Dong Sik has no clue that In Woo is the one behind the blackmail and prepares for murder. Meanwhile, Bo Kyung, who thinks former police officer Park Moo Suk is the informant, finds his body.

11.o: Bo Kyung starts having doubts about Dong Sik being a nice guy and attempts to get a sample of his DNA. Dong Sik, who is agonizing over the fact he killed Park Moo Suk, returns the million dollars to In Woo and decides to leave town. However, as Dong Sik leaves town, he soon realizes that he left the red diary at the restaurant he was at with In Woo.

12.o: Bo Kyung arrests Dong Sik as the predator serial killer, and Dong Sik stands in front of the press for pictures. However, after Dong Sik gets sentenced to life in prison, Bo Kyung comes across evidence that might prove Dong Sik's innocence. In prison, Dong Sik meets Oh Myung Dal, who was wrongfully accused of Son Ji Min's murder eight years ago, and during a chaotic moment, his real identity flashes before his eyes.

13.o: Bo Kyung digs into her uncle's death and finds evidence proving Dong Sik's innocence. However, she falls victim to In Wook's watchful eyes and finds herself in a dire situation. Meanwhile, in prison, Dong Sik gets put on disciplinary action, and without any time or choice, he makes a daring escape.

14.o: Dong Sik's memory returns to him with Bo Kyung's help. When he realizes In Wook is the serial killer playing him as the fool, rage takes over him. Finally, Bo Kyung and Chil Sung help Dong Sik start to make his move to turn the tables on In Wook.

15.o: To find evidence pinning In Woo to Chairman Seo Choong Hyun's murder, Dong Sik devises and starts a new plan. While Bo Kyung hooks In Woo up to a lie detector for further questioning, Dong Sik and Chil Sung search In Wook's place and discover his hideout. Meanwhile, Dong Sik's colleagues at Daehan Securities post rumors regarding the mystery behind the chairman's murder.

16.o: It's the final battle between Dong Sik and In Woo. With the police heading their way, Dong Sik fights off In Woo, who has a gun pointed at Bo Kyung's face. As the police arrive, gunshots echo down the emergency stairway. Who will be the victor? In Woo, the psychopath serial killer? Or Dong Sik, the pushover?

1.o: يصبح "جون وين غيسي" هو المشتبه به الرئيسي في اختفاء المراهق "روبرت بيست"، وتكشف أشرطة صوتية لم يسمعها أحد من قبل عن أفكار "غيسي" وبداياته.

2.o: يبدأ "غيسي" في التصرف بغرابة بعد اعتراف مطوّل، ما يضطرّ الشرطة إلى التعامل مع تصرفاته ومع تحقيق بدأ يأخذ منحًى مغايرًا، على حدّ سواء.

3.o: فيما يحاول محامو "غيسي" بناء حجة دفاع تقوم على عدم سلامة قواه العقلية، تتولى الشرطة مهمة شاقة ومثيرة للعواطف لتحديد وتكريم كل فرد من ضحاياه.

1.t: A Lying Witch and a Warden
1.o: Luz, a self-assured teenage girl, accidentally stumbles upon a portal to a magical world where she befriends a rebellious witch, Eda, and an adorably tiny warrior, King. In order to get home, Luz must help them with a mission.

2.o: When an ancient wizard gives Luz a map for a mystical quest, she wonders if she is actually a Chosen One.

3.o: Luz sneaks into the local magic school to help a friend and makes a new enemy in the process.

4.o: Luz and King have to defend the Owl House from a mysterious intruder.

5.o: Luz's lesson about witch covens goes awry when she finds herself thrust into a witch's duel.

6.o: When Luz, Willow and Gus accidentally animate the Owl House, the house runs amok around Bonesborough.

7.o: While checking out the library, Luz's pranks lead to unintended consequences.

8.o: A simple disagreement leads to a complex situation when Eda, King, and Luz triple-down on a wager.

9.o: When Gus sneaks Luz into Hexside School to present at the Human Appreciation Society, Luz sees a side of the school she didn't expect.

10.o: When an adventure with Eda's staff goes awry, Luz and her friends have to earn the staff back from a mysterious forest creature, or lose the staff forever.

11.o: When King becomes a bestselling author, he learns a valuable lesson in reading the fine print.

12.o: Luz needs to learn a new spell, so Eda takes her to the most magical place on the island to train.

13.o: During Luz’s first day of Magic School, curiosity gets the best of her, and she finds herself thrown into the Delinquent Track, where she’s not allowed to learn magic.

14.o: King confides in a carnival fortuneteller who makes his dream come true, but it comes at a cost.

15.o: Luz, Willow and Amity take a trip down memory lane.

16.o: Luz experiences Grom, Hexside’s version of Prom, and it’s not what she expects.

18.o: On a school field trip to the mysterious Emperor’s Castle, Luz strays from the group and into danger.

19.o: Luz’s skills as a witch are put to the test when she attempts the impossible.

1.o: Kamala Khan attends Avengercon only to discover that she herself might have superpowers.

2.o: Kamala and Bruno explore the source of her newfound powers just in time for a perilous adventure.

3.o: Ahead of Aamir’s wedding, Kamala may face grave consequences due to a crucial decision she makes.

4.o: Kamala travels around the world to solve the mystery of the bangle and her family’s history.

5.o: The bangle reveals to Kamala secrets about her family lineage, as well as the truth behind the Veil.

6.o: Back in Jersey, Kamala finds Kamran and protects him from Damage Control who will stop at nothing to take him in.

1.o: Filthy and J.B. are superstars on the Hughes middle school basketball team, but find themselves drifting apart when J.B starts pursuing other interests. Chuck suffers an attack on the court and is taken to the hospital, leading to questions about his health and ability to coach. When a new girl arrives at Hughes, Filthy falls head over heels in love—only to see his brother make the first move.

2.o: The Langston Lions are cursed with an epic losing streak. To make things worse, Filthy's long-time rival, Zuma, has been talking smack about his game performance on social media. Convinced that Voodoo is the solution for it all, Filthy travels to Congo Square with Maya, Vondie, and J.B. for answers—only to learn that there's no shortcut to winning and believing in yourself.

3.o: It's Harlem Renaissance dance night at Hughes, and expectations are sky-high. Filthy's determined to make his last middle school dance a hit, but JB wants to dance away his problems—like an overdue essay he lied about writing. But even the best laid plans go awry when a thunderstorm hits, tensions between the twins rise to a boiling point, and family secrets are forced to come into the light.

4.o: In a bid to secure his spot at ultra-competitive Beacon Academy, Filthy takes up an invite from one of their most respected ballers to their Friday night hang spot—The Wheel House skating rink. A jealous J.B. loses his cool when their Beacon hits on Alexis. To avenge his brother, Filthy intervenes, which leads to an ugly public altercation.

5.o: A surprise visit from Grandma Barbara and Chuck's childhood best friend, Skinny sets the Bells on the right path. After a tense family game, Filthy and J.B. finally come to a truce. Chuck is inspired to make a call to someone he hasn't spoken to in years in a last-chance attempt to cure his disease. Crystal learns that a video of the kids' fight at the roller ink is making the rounds at school.

6.o: After the hijinks at The Wheel House, Filthy's status in school has elevated. Crystal is left to pick up the pieces after the school administration—and a parent from Beacon Academy—pressure her to remedy the situation, and fast. As principal and mom, she's forced to make a tough decision that Filthy can't fully accept.

7.o: Filthy, devastated by his suspension from the team, struggles to find meaning in his life without basketball. He seeks advice from a few unlikely sources, ultimately diving deeper into his love of language and poetry. He surfaces with an inspired speech to rally the team for the upcoming City Championship. Crystal has a secret meeting that may change Chuck's life—for better or worse.

8.o: At the City Championship game against Lakeside, an unexpected family reunion sets the Bell family on a hopeful new trajectory. Filthy tries to reveal his feelings to Maya, but it may be too late. J.B. learns the devastating reason Alexis has been avoiding him. The Crew says their goodbyes to Hughes. Chuck must make a difficult choice that disrupts J.B. and Filthy's futures.

1.t: Summoned to Another World for a Second Time
1.o: After his reincarnation from another world, Setsu leads a new life as a high school student.  However, for an unknown reason, he is summoned back to the same world, Eclair.  Before he can enjoy his return, he becomes embroiled in the war with the demons that he had originally ended.  Though his old comrades rush to his aid, he also notices his old friend's magic on the battlefield.  What is going on in the world of Eclair that Setsu enters for the second time?"

2.t: Going on a Trip for a Second Time
2.o: Setsu sets off for the demonic continent - and into a chance meeting with the granddaughter of a certain merchant he met once in his previous life, who has her own duty to fulfill...

3.t: Frying a Squid for a Second Time
3.o: Setsu, Ruri, and Levia arrive on the demonic continent. They reconnect with old acquaintances and are swept up in a sinister plot involving the Demon Lord and a mysterious merchant.

4.t: A Gift for the Second Time
4.o: The Demon Lord Dezastol reflects on the previous war and the promise of peace she made to Setsu. Meanwhile, Setsu, Levia, and Vlad rush to rescue her from the unwanted marriage to the mysterious Terran Sneeter.

5.t: In Hot Pursuit for the Second Time
5.o: While Setsu is fighting his battles on the demonic continent, Yuhi trains to become strong enough to stand by his side. With the help of Elka's tough love, she discovers her own unique kind of determination.

6.t: Taking an Apprentice for a Second Time
6.o: Setsu and Levia set off for the Beastmen continent. On their way, they cross paths with Setsu's old friend Alizee and discover she has been battling a mysterious dragon. Together, they unravel the shocking truth.

7.t: On the Beast Continent for a Second Time
7.o: Arriving at the Beastmen continent, Setsu and Levia meet Shironeko, a fierce fighter. When Shironeko is asked to assassinate Setsu, she agrees for the sake of her ill sister. All is not what it seems, though, and Setsu uncovers a tangled web of deceit.

8.t: Fighting a Duel for a Second Time
8.o: Setsu meets more old allies in the Beastman capital, reuniting with the King Regulus and his daughter Roa. Old rivalries run hot, and Setsu finds himself in a duel that isn't what it seems...

1.t: Deuk Pal Goes to High School
1.o: Deuk Pal is about to become the boss of the Chilsung Gang. While mulling over giving up his dream of going to university, he tries to save Yi Heon from jumping off a bridge. Unfortunately, Deuk Pal loses his life but takes over Yi Heon's body. He learns of Yi Heon's misfortunes and resolves to avenge his suffering as a victim of bullying.

2.t: You Are Not Song Yi Heon
2.o: Deuk Pal, now inhabiting Yi Heon’s body, arouses suspicion from Se Kyung due to his noticeable deviation from his usual self. Despite Deuk Pal's attempts to mimic Yi Heon's behaviour, the other kids begin to question the sudden change in him. Particularly with Jae Min persisting in ridiculing Yi Heon, Deuk Pal plots a subtle revenge for him.

3.o: Deuk Pal proves he can fight in Yi Heon's body and gains control over Jae Min and his underlings. The kids at school can't believe how different Yi Heon is and are shocked. Se Kyung gets DNA testing done to see if Yi Heon is still the Yi Heon he knows, and Deuk Pal focuses on his studies and setting things right for Yi Heon. Meanwhile, Deuk Pal learns about what happened the night before Yi Heon died from Se Kyung as they become closer.

4.o: Deuk Pal and Se Kyung save Yi Heon's mom from getting kidnapped. Luckily, she was unharmed. Although he has a hunch about who might be responsible, Deuk Pal vows to protect Yi Heon and his family without the police involved. Meanwhile, Jae Min approaches Deuk Pal to find out if the police are looking for him, but Se Kyung confronts him about his involvement in the attempted kidnapping.

5.o: Se Kyung witnesses Yi Heon getting abducted but can't do anything about it because he remembers Yi Heon telling him not to call the police about anything. He asks Jae Min for help, but Jae Min cowards out. Meanwhile, Yi Heon deals with the gangsters and tells them things that shock them.

6.o: Deuk Pal and Se Kyung go to see the ocean and have a day off. Se Kyung talks about his father who’s been trying to control him since young and how it made him stressed and suffocating. Se Kyung’s father comes to school and calls for the violence committee. Meanwhile, Deuk Pal finds out that Yi Heon’s mother has been taking addictive medicine.

7.o: Deuk Pal found out that the school bullies reported Yi Heon for school violence. He orders Dong Soo and the gang to get Lee Mi Kyung since she is the one behind them. Byung Chul tells Jae Min to join him and report Yi Heon as well. Jae Min feels guilty about falsely charging Yi Heon, but he's also scared that he might end up going to the juvie if the truth is revealed.

8.o: Jae Min confesses to bullying Yi Heon and other kids at school. Thanks to Jae Min, the charges are dropped, but Deuk Pal still needs to find Mi Kyung so that she won't come back to threaten Yi Heon and his mother again. He decides to meet Chairman Bae and set everything right. Meanwhile, Yi Heon's soul returns and tells Deuk Pal that he does not have much time left.
